test_apply_augmentations: test applying a list of augmentation transforms to a numpy image array
test_apply_rotated_box: test transforming rotated bounding boxes through a composed transform chain
test_apply_box_and_polygons: test transforming axis-aligned bounding boxes and polygon annotations through augmentations
test_random_apply: test probabilistically wrapping an augmentation with RandomApply to control application probability
test_resize_and_extent_transforms: test ResizeTransform and ExtentTransform for resizing images and cropping regions to a target size
